scenes.title: Choose the unit and distinguish its group

ordered_spans.speech: Search for Engine to narrow the sheet. The Groups entry called Engine 51 and the unit called Engine 51 are separate choices. In this example the group is unchecked and the unit is checked. Read the unit’s Available status, Herrmann’s crew assignment and At station position source. Its Nearest number three badge is its place among the board’s available units; it does not say that three engines are selected. The row shows an estimated travel time, while the board can rank units using turnout plus travel. Confirm returns the selected recipients to the call form. It is still separate from creating or dispatching the call.
